fact: A TikTok creator was arrested and held in custody on 11 June 2026 after posting an AI-generated image of former president Patrice Talon, following the CNIN's 29 May 2026 warning citing article 576 of the Code du numérique.
title: Bénin : un tiktokeur arrêté après la diffusion d'une image de Patrice Talon générée par l'IA.
